📢 Content Update (Published: October 27, 2026 / Previously posted: October 28, 2026)

Main changes: The city website's contact form, event calendar, RSS feed integration, and page ID search have been restored. The email delivery system and Nishikawa Broad-Area Forest Cooperative website remain offline.

City Website Functions Resume

Most city website functions that were temporarily suspended due to emergency security measures for PHP programming language vulnerabilities (applying security patches) have now been fully restored.

Several services are still being worked on for restoration as follows.

We apologize for the inconvenience and disruption this has caused. These are essential safety measures to ensure you can use our services securely, and we ask for your understanding and cooperation.

We will inform you promptly once services are restored.

【Services Currently Offline】

1. Email Delivery System
2. Nishikawa Broad-Area Forest Cooperative Website

【Suspension Period】

The restart timeline is unknown at this time. However, services will be brought back online in sequence once safety measures are completed.

【Related Link】

National Cyber Security Center (Alerts & Advisories) on X

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/sogoseisakubu/hishokohoka/joho/14546.html
summary: ℹ️ Some city website functions have resumed
